_about.note: Frozen answer key for the single-run walk (Plan 2 Task 5b), read from the retained run files with shasum/python, independently of engine/store.py and web/views.js. Values are the file values; the UI may format differently (dates, 'USD' prefixes, hash shortening, 'candidate' wording, spend rounding) and the walk must compare after undoing that formatting, not edit this file. IMPORTANT: the folder id is cpos-launch-cp2-reader-001 but every file records run_id 'tdg-2024-09-30-credit_snapshot-sol-medium'; the key lists both and the walk must use the folder id to address the run (store key) and the recorded run_id only where the UI shows it. The run folder holds no events.jsonl and no intake status.json, so the Run activity event assertions cannot be exercised by this fixture (see activity). Paths are relative to the repo root; <D> = runs/cpos-launch-cp2-reader-001/deliveries/aed8a979aefbfe1816136219283054ed39121dfcd3c9d0db85e6098f1e676a1c/.
